summary: Forest Lookouts lists a South Carolina Forestry Commission tower in Calhoun County; no source gives its build date, height or current condition.

facts.status_note: No source we read says whether the tower still stands.

evidence.supports: tower listed under the South Carolina Forestry Commission
first Forestry Commission fire tower erected near Camden in August 1930
evidence.quote: The first Forestry Commission fire tower was erected in August, 1930 near Camden.

evidence.supports: two towers each took a bearing on a smoke
evidence.quote: When a smoke was spotted, each of two towers would record its direction using a large compass table and a sighting device called an alidade.

evidence.supports: fire placed where the two readings crossed on a map
evidence.quote: The fire was located at the spot where these readings crossed when plotted on a map.

evidence.supports: agency says its fire tower system closed October 1, 1993; the date covers the whole system
evidence.quote: The Forestry Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993.

evidence.supports: network of more than 130 towers, used 65 years to detect wildfires
evidence.quote: The tower network eventually included more than 130 towers and was used for 65 years to detect wildfires.

evidence.supports: Post and Courier gives 1994 as the year the system was decommissioned
evidence.quote: The SCFC lookout tower system was decommissioned in 1994.

evidence.supports: Post and Courier says the agency closed the last of its lookout towers in 1993
evidence.quote: In 1993, the Forestry Commission closed the last of its forest fire lookout towers.

evidence.supports: only 30 of the state's towers remain standing
evidence.quote: Today, only 30 of them remain standing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The SCFC gives October 1, 1993 as the date it closed its fire tower system. The Post and Courier says the agency closed the last of its towers in 1993 and gives 1994 for decommissioning. The story reports the agency's 1993 date as the system closure and both newspaper dates, and does not treat them as a contradiction.

sources.title: Looking out for last fire towers

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts Calhoun page gives only county and agency. The record's coordinates 33.7266, -80.8812 were not checked against any source. A TopoQuest search did not return a Calhoun Lookout Tower. A search snippet mentioned a Calhoun Falls antenna structure registered to the SCFC; it was not read and is not linked to this record. The NHLR and FFLOS caches have no entry for this tower. State Library of South Carolina PDFs returned HTTP 403 and were not read. Two WebSearch calls were used. The SCFC gives 1993 for the system closure. The Post and Courier gives 1993 for the last tower closing and 1994 for decommissioning; the story states these dates.
